name: appsec
description: 2 security scanning skills: appsec-scan (catalog-driven CI mirror — single-command scan (run-scan.sh) + normalized findings/triage statuses for small-model execution; admin-managed scanner preference profiles pointing at the configured instance's private GitLab CI/CD Catalog, 4 components (Fortify SCA SAST multi-language incl. go, Dependency Scanning SBOM, Secret Detection, Container Scanning) with per-component version pinning (~latest or exact tag) and the scanner image derived from the component template; an optional glci engine that runs the real catalog component job locally for secret detection and container scanning, and optional GitLab-native dependency-scanning matching via a remote helper project, alongside the default docker engine and offline Trivy match; mirror-availability checks that route unobtainable upgrades and base images to a batched platform-team request; approval-gated fix loop and a guided Vulnerability Report triage plan) and appsec-dast-sim (LLM-based DAST following OWASP WSTG v4.2 — no running app required).
